mapper.select: SELECT i.store_id AS "storeId", it.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(it.qty - COALESCE(it.received_qty, 0)) AS "qty", MIN(i.eta_date) AS "eta" FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE i.status = 'SHIPPED' AND it.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY i.store_id, it.material_id

SELECT st.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(st.qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.material_id IN #{id} AND st.warehouse_id IN (SELECT s.warehouse_id FROM ecom_store s WHERE s.status = 1) AND st.warehouse_id NOT IN (SELECT p.platform_warehouse_id FROM ecom_store p WHERE p.platform_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY st.material_id

SELECT i.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(GREATEST(i.qty - i.done_qty + COALESCE(i.replenish_qty, 0), 0)) AS "qty", MIN(CASE WHEN i.qty - i.done_qty + COALESCE(i.replenish_qty, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(i.delivery_date, o.delivery_date) END) AS "eta" FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY i.material_id

SELECT it.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(it.qty - COALESCE(it.received_qty, 0)) AS "qty", MIN(i.eta_date) AS "eta" FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE i.status = 'SHIPPED' AND it.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY it.material_id

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, sp.name AS supplier_name, o.order_date, COALESCE(i.delivery_date, o.delivery_date) AS delivery_date, o.status, i.qty, i.done_qty, GREATEST(i.qty - i.done_qty + COALESCE(i.replenish_qty, 0), 0) AS open_qty FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON sp.id = o.partner_id WHERE o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND i.material_id = #{materialId} AND i.qty - i.done_qty + COALESCE(i.replenish_qty, 0) > 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(i.delivery_date, o.delivery_date), o.id

SELECT i.id AS inbound_id, i.doc_no, s.name AS store_name, i.shipment_id, it.seller_sku, i.ship_date, i.eta_date, it.qty, it.received_qty, it.qty - COALESCE(it.received_qty, 0) AS open_qty FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = i.store_id WHERE i.status = 'SHIPPED' AND it.material_id = #{materialId} AND i.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY i.eta_date, i.id
